title: Provider declarations
description: What a provider declares, whatever its categories: how an outcome can be followed (REQ-CAT-16, every provider). A provider that advertises a reserve, exchange or ramp also declares the evidence it gives and for how long (REQ-CAT-10, REQ-ORD-39, ADR-0007), and whether a repeat is safe (REQ-CAT-10); the advertisement schema requires them there. A verifier-only provider serves no segment and may leave them out (DEC-16).

tracking.description: At least one of: each transaction carries an identifier; the provider answers a status query. REQ-CAT-16, no exceptions.

grade.description: The grade the provider gives on every outcome, so its weakest, on ADR-0007's scale: 1 checkable by anyone; 2 signed by another party; 3 signed by the provider, with something external to compare later; 4 the provider's bare statement. The operator's per-tuple floor (REQ-ORD-39) compares against it.

availability.description: How long evidence of an outcome stays available: a number of seconds from the outcome, or "unbounded".

safe_retry.description: Whether a repeat is safe. Where false, a retry is never sent (REQ-CAT-10).
